rationale: The Court is likely to reverse on a Public Citizen–style proximate-cause/agency-authority limit, requiring a hard look at construction/operations and directly induced rail-traffic effects but rejecting a categorical duty to quantify upstream drilling and downstream combustion. Roberts is best positioned to hold the 7-Justice coalition with a narrow, administrable rule, while Sotomayor and/or Jackson likely write dissents emphasizing foreseeability and anti-segmentation.
